metrics.ITL_contract: Frozen event-average delivery intervals. Exact individual token-generation times are not measured when delivery is coalesced.
metrics.latency_scope: Marker-free output-delivery metrics unless the configuration enables device events or state hashing.
metrics.throughput_scope: Finite-cohort drain rates. Not sustainable serving capacity.

frozen_SLO.rule: Two times serial calibration percentiles. Use the tighter per-metric limit across Atomic and C2048. Freeze before held-out pilot serving.

collector.scope: Export occurs after measured serving. CUDA synchronization occurs only during close.

decode.scope: All-stream union for the selected model-stage process and device. Not SM occupancy. Copies are not measured in the kernel-only collector.
decode.cross_process_device_activity_scope: Inspect both stage record-device inventories before calling this a complete physical-device union.
